scenes.keyframe_visual: Early morning light through the blinds, Priya at her laptop with an unsent HR complaint on screen, Anu standing in the doorway with her tote half off her shoulder
scenes.camera: static, screen glow lighting Priya's face

dialogue.line: I haven't sent it. Not yet.
dialogue.voice: Indian woman, late 20s, warm even tone, careful word choice

dialogue.line: Don't send it. I want to say it myself.
dialogue.voice: young Indian woman, early 20s, quick Mumbai English, slightly breathless when nervous
Indian woman, late 20s, warm even tone, careful word choice

scenes.micro_acting: Priya's finger hovers over the trackpad without clicking, Anu grips the doorframe then steps in and sets the tote down
scenes.narrative_job: continue cliffhanger, Anu chooses to speak before Priya acts

scenes.keyframe_visual: Vikram now in the glass doorway behind Anu, ID lanyard still on, Priya half-risen from her chair, Anu pulling out her phone
scenes.camera: static wide, frames all three through the glass

dialogue.voice: middle-aged Indian man, low measured baritone, precise English, long pauses

dialogue.line: No sir. It's mine. I'm recording it.
dialogue.voice: young Indian woman, early 20s, quick Mumbai English, slightly breathless when nervous
Indian woman, late 20s, warm even tone, careful word choice
middle-aged Indian man, low measured baritone, precise English, long pauses

scenes.micro_acting: Vikram's hand rests on the doorframe, Anu's thumb presses record, Priya half-rises then stops herself
scenes.narrative_job: escalate three-way confrontation, Vikram allows the note

scenes.keyframe_visual: Anu holding her phone up, screen lighting her chin, Priya seated watching with both hands off the mouse, Vikram still in the doorway
scenes.camera: tight static close-up moving to a slow dolly across all three faces

dialogue.line: I was scared, sir. That you'd stop paying me.
dialogue.voice: young Indian woman, early 20s, quick Mumbai English, slightly breathless when nervous

dialogue.line: That's why I never... I never said no.
dialogue.voice: young Indian woman, early 20s, quick Mumbai English, slightly breathless when nervous
Indian woman, late 20s, warm even tone, careful word choice
middle-aged Indian man, low measured baritone, precise English, long pauses

scenes.micro_acting: Anu's voice cracks but she keeps holding record, voice breaks on 'never', Priya presses her lips together, Vikram takes his glasses off
scenes.narrative_job: the honest note spoken aloud, names the fear, sets up reversal

scenes.keyframe_visual: Vikram stepping into his cabin doorway, the white envelope visible on his desk through the glass, Anu and Priya just outside
scenes.camera: tracking shot following Vikram in, holding on the envelope and his face

dialogue.line: No more envelopes. From Monday, you're on payroll.
dialogue.voice: middle-aged Indian man, low measured baritone, precise English, long pauses

dialogue.line: Sir... I'm still scared, honestly. Is that okay?
dialogue.voice: young Indian woman, early 20s, quick Mumbai English, slightly breathless when nervous

dialogue.line: It's fine. Strategy associate, reporting to Priya.
dialogue.voice: middle-aged Indian man, low measured baritone, precise English, long pauses
Indian woman, late 20s, warm even tone, careful word choice

scenes.micro_acting: Vikram picks up the envelope, looks at it, sets it down unopened; Anu's voice drops, hands tight on the tote strap; Priya almost smiles
scenes.narrative_job: reversal, the paid deal ends and a real visible job replaces it

scenes.keyframe_visual: Anu alone in the elevator, a new ID lanyard held loose in her hand instead of clipped on, doors starting to slide shut
scenes.camera: static medium inside elevator, doors closing across her face
scenes.micro_acting: Anu alone, one long breath out, a small unsteady half-laugh without words, eyes on the elevator numbers
scenes.narrative_job: cliffhanger, can she stay honest without payment

new_facts.fact: Anu says aloud to both Priya and Vikram that her real fear is losing the paid arrangement
Vikram ends the cash-envelope deal and offers Anu a formal strategy associate role reporting to Priya
Priya closes her laptop without sending the HR complaint
